title: Hytale
shortDescription: Hytale helps define a PC (Windows) adventure and sandbox path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Brings a source-aware adventure and sandbox entry to the PC (Windows) browsing route.
Retains source provenance while keeping the catalog context method-generated.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Registered for the PC (Windows) adventure and sandbox discovery path using a source-linked Wikidata item; this remains source-aware discovery without copied review text.
